name: capped-promise
description: Provides Promise.all and Promise.allSettled variants that limit the number of simultaneously pending promises.

scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test
scripts.preversion: git checkout develop && git push && git pull
scripts.version: git flow release start v`cat package.json | jq -r '.version' && git stash push >/dev/null 2>&1` && git stash pop
scripts.postversion: git commit -a -m "chore: start release v`cat package.json | jq -r '.version'`"
scripts.finish-release: git flow release finish -p -m "chore: finish release" v`cat package.json | jq -r '.version'`
